metadata.description: Fifteen Instagram skills for Claude Code and Codex, merged from two MIT bundles, behind a publish gate that is enforced at runtime rather than documented.

plugins.name: instagram-stack
plugins.description: Fifteen Instagram skills: niche reading through Apify, caption and carousel writing against 26 documented hook formulas, reel and story scripting, a 199-entry anti-slop humaniser that returns its own replacements, profile scoring on a 12-criterion rubric, weekly planning, post-mortem auditing, and comment and reply drafting. Publishing passes an approval gate enforced in code: nothing reaches a provider without a live approval bound to the exact payload, and the bundle is read-only until armed from the launch environment. Drafting needs no keys, no accounts and no network.
